title: Mass of the current obtained by integrating over a ball
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on ℝ^P. Let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n, the continuous linear functionals on Covector (Euclid P) n) satisfy |ξ(y)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. y and every α ∈ Λ^n(ℝ^P), where |·| is covectorEuclideanNorm. Let x ∈ ℝ^P and ρ ∈ ℝ, and let A ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) satisfy A(ω) = ∫_{B_ρ(x)} ξ(y)(ω(y)) dμ(y) for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), where B_ρ(x) is the open ball. Then M(A) ≤ μ(B_ρ(x)) in [0, ∞], where M(A) = A.mass = M_{ℝ^P}(A).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (x : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ y α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, A ω = ∫ y in ball x ρ, ξ y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ∂μ) → A.mass ≤ μ (ball x ρ)
